payload.blocks: Only step (f) of the phase 6 amendment; the workspace, register and test amendments go on.
payload.headline: When a sleeping lead wakes, does it resume its old CLI session (full transcript) or start fresh with the handoff?

parts.cause: Many agent systems resume the full transcript on wake. Resume keeps everything the lead knew but carries stale observations, costs a full re-read once the prompt cache expired, works only for the same CLI, and is the very context a rotation exists to drop.

options.cost: One branch in the wake start and one more owning test.
options.does: At sleep the keeper records the context fraction and CLI session id in the head record. On wake: below sessionRotation soft and the seat binds the same CLI, resume that session with a wake line telling it to re-read plan and git; otherwise a fresh session with the handoff.
options.gain: No knowledge loss for short or light sleeps; rotation rules still decide when context is too full.
options.harm: Two wake paths to test; a resumed lead may trust facts that changed while it slept unless the wake line forces a re-read.
options.label: Resume below soft, else handoff

options.does: Sleep writes a handoff through the rotation writer (reason sleep); the successor gets it, the plan files and a transcript pointer.
options.gain: One path, same as rotation; small clean context; works across CLIs and accounts.
options.harm: Loses what the handoff did not write down: failed attempts, reasoning, nuances.
options.label: Always fresh with handoff

options.does: Every wake resumes the old CLI session.
options.harm: Full context comes back even when it was near the hard threshold; breaks when the seat moves to another CLI or account.
options.label: Always resume

parts.recommendation: Resume below soft, else handoff: it keeps the lead's memory when that is cheap and safe, and falls back to the rotation path when it is not.

scope.allows: Deciding how a woken lead gets its previous session, as a phase 6 amendment.
scope.forbids: Changing rotation thresholds or the handoff format for ordinary rotations.

parts.what: Skeleton phase 6 stops an idle lead with reason sleep and starts a successor later. Today every successor is a fresh session that gets the lineage handoff and the last message, never the transcript.
